Hi Mike,

There is a copy of the DCI tournament rules for VTES at my website.
Also there is a clarification of the "No Repeat Actions" and vote
replacement clauses of the DC rules (the DC rules aren't thorough
enough). In addition there is a link to LSJ's rulings and errata
catalog. Finally, if you'll forward me the addresses of the interested
parties, I'll even mail them a set of LSJ's Rulings and Errata catalog,
a copy of the DC rules, and a shiny new copy of our Los Angeles Area
Players' newsletter.

LA Tournament News: http://www.cs.ucr.edu/~ezix/other/rg/vtourn_1.html
